Shared-contract and Relay tests reject credential and manifest environment mismatches before authorization or activation.
Production configuration accepts only public Relay and trusted-key input. Missing or invalid configuration fails closed. No production endpoint, credential, key generation, or deployment was used.
The API 30 development client rejected a schema-valid local development manifest with an invalid detached signature and retained verified-cache sequence 1.
After the same local Relay restored its normal fixture, Refresh returned fresh-verified policy and idle controls.

runtimeObservations.nativeBusyObservation: A temporary 14-second hold of the task-owned local development workerd kept the normal HMAC and D1 fixture request pending below the client timeout. The API 30 hierarchy then showed Checking installation, Checking capability policy, verified-cache retention, Retrying installation busy, and Refreshing policy busy. The helper resumed the fixture in finally, after which the hierarchy and screenshot showed fresh-verified with ordinary action labels. This is a controlled local fixture delay, not network performance evidence.
